proposition: Under Article 56 of the Statute, ECCA's first-instance intervention and interest in the result did not by themselves confer appellate standing; because the General Court judgment was not shown to directly affect ECCA's own legal situation, the appeal was inadmissible.
scope_note: This proposition is confined to intervener appellate standing under Article 56. It is not a proposition on Article 263 standing generally and does not determine the pesticide-science or regulatory merits.
